notation: KFGQPC targets were folded before learning: Arabic Extended-B attached alefs and U+0671 all read as U+0671 ALEF WASLA, and the waṣl vowel cues on that alef (U+06EC, U+06EA, U+06EB, U+065C) are dropped; elsewhere U+06EA and U+065C are kept, since the Dūrī and Warsh releases use them as the imālah and taqlīl dots. U+06E1 (KFGQPC sukun head) reads as U+0652; the v2 open-tanwīn marks read as U+08F0–U+08F2; a tanwīn is written before the alef or alef maqṣūrah it sits on, as the documents and the 2022 releases write it; yeh barree U+06D2 reads as U+064A; alef madda U+0622 is decomposed so the madda stays a mark. Hamza seats (أ إ ؤ ئ) are kept. The decoded text is in this notation; compare across tiers through fold_notation.
